bullets.text: Ofcom's 5G Spectrum Auction - Ofcom will auction 5.4 GHz of mmWave spectrum, the largest release in UK history.
6G's Undefined Future - Analysts question the economic viability and clarity of 6G's purpose in the telecom landscape.
Neighborhood AI Factories Rise - Telco central offices are transforming into AI hubs, enhancing local processing capabilities.
Newcastle's Free Wi-Fi Initiative - Newcastle City Council partners with **Purple** to expand free Wi-Fi access across the city.
EE's 5G Speed Solution - **EE** deploys Advanced RAN Coordination to enhance 5G speeds in crowded areas.
Unabiz Restructures Sigfox - Unabiz secures court protection to restructure €5m debt while maintaining global operations.
Starlink's Spectrum Acquisition - **SpaceX** buys spectrum to enhance its Direct to Cell mobile service capabilities.
AI Efficiency in Telecoms - Companies are leveraging AI to drive operational efficiency and streamline network management.
